No. A query's own `"flags"` cannot set `--max-columns`. The check is in `src/main.zig:1887`, which returns the error message: `--max-columns is per call: put it on the command line, not in "flags"`. That fires when the per-query parsed options have `max_columns != null` (`vo.max_columns != null`).

Where the value comes from instead:
- It is parsed as a command-line option at `src/main.zig:1188` and `src/main.zig:1198`.
- The global option is applied to the JSON output at `src/main.zig:1966` (`out_json.max_columns = gopts.max_columns orelse 0`).
- `src/main.zig:2038` and `src/main.zig:2120` keep the batch-wide value while a batch is running (`batch_running`).

The context doesn't show the code around line 1887, so I can't say exactly how "flags" are parsed into `vo`.
